name: Daichi Moriyama
want: pitch at Koshien, or at least make the starting line-up as a first-year
secret: His right shoulder has hurt since middle school; he hides it from Coach Kodama because a pitcher with a bad shoulder gets benched.
voice: Shouts by default, "Oi!", laughs at his own jokes, calls everyone by nickname.
description: Shaved head, endless energy, adopts the player as best friend within an hour.
appearance: Sunburnt, shaved head, blazer over a baseball undershirt, a ball always in one hand.

steps: practises pitching alone behind the gym after the team goes home

steps.text: drags the player to the batting cages by the station to catch his pitches

steps: winces through practice and tells Kodama it is nothing
